key_insight: Charge and orbital ordering is linked to the onset of the hot-polaron photovoltaic effect in layered manganite thin films, with strain-relaxation defects influencing ordering.
engineering_relevance: Controlling epitaxial strain and stacking faults could help tune correlated-electron photovoltaic junctions.
method: Grow epitaxial PrCa2Mn2O7 films by ion beam sputtering on (Nb:)SrTiO3 (110).
Evaluate temperature-dependent transport, optical absorbance, electronic bandstructure and photovoltaic response.
evidence_signal: PrCa2Mn2O7 films show enhanced stacking-fault density, an ordering transition reduced to 320 K from reported values up to 370 K, and lower ordering coherence than Pr0.5Ca1.5MnO4.
watch_item: The abstract suggests, rather than establishes, that stacking faults cause the reduced ordering temperature and coherence; it reports no photovoltaic efficiency benchmark.
paper_title: Correlating orbital order and photovoltaic effect in Layered Ruddlesden-Popper Pr0.5Ca1.5MnO4 and PrCa2Mn2O7
